title: BTD10: The 835kph Sailplane and Dynamic Soaring
summary: Spencer Lisenby explains dynamic soaring, a technique that lets unpowered radio-controlled gliders reach speeds above 835 kph. He covers the physics and the design, build and flying challenges.
why: Recommended as a detailed, wonderful explanation of the physics of dynamic soaring and record-speed RC gliders.

quote.text: Here's a really wonderful talk by Spencer Lisenby about the basic physics
